languages.answer: The app is available in Spanish and English, and you can switch languages in Settings.
languages.question: What languages does it support?

photos.answer: They're private by default: we only use them to extract the text. Sharing a rulebook with your game's community is optional and reversible. Read more in the Privacy Policy.
photos.question: What happens to my photos?

reliable.answer: Usually, but it's not infallible. Every answer includes a citation to the rulebook page so you can check the source in one tap. If something feels off, the original page wins.
reliable.question: Can I trust what the AI says?

hero.description: Manualito reads your board game's rulebook and explains it in plain English. When a question comes up mid-game, ask it.

title.line1: From the box to the table

academic.description: Final degree project in progress: you may run into a bug or two. Your reports are gold.
academic.title: Manualito is a TFG (final degree project)

contact.description: Questions, bugs, or games we haven't read quite right.

ask.description: Table-side questions mid-game: a short answer with the source right beside it.
ask.title: Ask it

capture.description: Snap the rulebook or upload the PDF. Multiple pages at once, in any order.
capture.title: Snap a photo

explain.description: AI sums up setup, turns, and how to win, with a citation to the original page.
explain.title: We explain it

read.description: OCR pulls the text from each page and flags any that aren't clear enough.
read.title: We read it
